name: ui8kit
description: ui8kit 2.0 monorepo: xgen (the generation layer: specs, schemas, fixtures and the generator), generated packages for Svelte, React, Vue and Solid (and Go templ), one shared app package, and one host app per runtime that serves every screen spec by name. Bun workspaces.

scripts.build:hosts: bun run --cwd apps/host-svelte build && bun run --cwd apps/host-react build && bun run --cwd apps/host-vue build && bun run --cwd apps/host-solid build
scripts.typecheck: bun run typecheck:xgen && bun run --filter "@ui8kit/svelte-ui" --filter "@ui8kit/react-ui" --filter "@ui8kit/vue-ui" --filter "@ui8kit/solid-ui" --filter "@ui8kit/app-shared" --filter "host-*" --filter "discovery" --filter "@ui8kit/panorama" --filter "@ui8kit/taste-data" --filter "@ui8kit/taste-screens" --filter "magazine" --parallel check
scripts.check:all: bun run build && bun run check && bun run typecheck && bun run build:hosts && bun run test && bun run lint:px && bun run e2e
